ToolBoxVAEDeGrid.description: Remove the 2px grid from Qwen Image / Qwen Image 2.1 / Wan 2.1 VAE decodes. Connect before resize, sharpening, upscaling or restoration. Auto calibrates per image and preserves clean images. removed_grid is a preview only.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.tooltip: Off passes the original image through untouched for A/B comparison.

mode.name: Mode
mode.tooltip: auto: calibrate each image; manual: use the limit below.

limit.name: Correction limit
limit.tooltip: Manual only; ignored in auto. Maximum per-pixel correction in 0–1 units. Too high may soften fine texture.

skip_when_clean.name: Skip clean images
skip_when_clean.tooltip: Preserve original pixels when no phase-locked 2px grid is detected. Off forces filtering.

grid_gain.name: Grid preview gain
grid_gain.tooltip: Amplifies removed_grid only; never changes the cleaned image.

grid_view.name: Grid preview view
grid_view.tooltip: Full frame or 4x/8x nearest-neighbor center crop. Preview only; the cleaned image is never cropped.

0.name: Image
0.tooltip: Cleaned image at its original resolution.

1.name: Removed grid
1.tooltip: Amplified correction centered on gray. Preview only. Recognizable subject detail suggests too high a limit.
